reference.title: Email tool promo reel
reference.notes: The sharpest copy and a real system with two colours only: red bracketed eyebrow captions that type in and out, a giant year numeral, a full-bleed dot matrix where the hollow dots are the stat, a slot-machine price roll, terminal errors, hub-and-spoke integrations. Studied from what the page shows publicly; rebuilt in Moovi's own code (packages/library/src/kits/launch) with our own fonts, sounds and assets.

parts.name: Giant number
parts.about: one number from the page, huge, counting up from zero with a lift, an accent hairline drawing under it and a mono label

parts.name: Slot roll
parts.about: each word rolls up through a clipped band like a mechanical counter, with a vertical smear mid-roll

parts.name: Mask wipe up
parts.about: the next shot rises from below behind a hard mask line and pushes the old one up, with a faint ghost

parts.name: Bar wipe
parts.about: six bands close from alternating sides with jittered starts and open on the next shot

parts.name: Terminal window
parts.about: a dark terminal: a typed command, output streaming line by line, a green success line

parts.name: Bracket Caption Typer
parts.about: a sentence sits in accent square brackets and types in letter by letter over its own faint ghost, the payoff words in accent, then backspaces out

params.out: backspace at 2.6x speed in the last 0.32 s

parts.name: Billboard Ghost Slide
parts.about: the line, ideally one huge word, slides in from the right edge with five ghost copies and stops hard, its fill running from a dark accent into ink

params.gradient: accent mixed 62% to ink, ink from 55%

parts.name: Ping Dot Kicker
parts.about: an accent dot pings with an expanding ring, then a short line drops in word by word on the eighth notes beside it

parts.name: Ink Line, Accent Line
parts.about: a two-line promise set ultra tight, the first line in ink and the second in accent, each word rising out of a soft blur

parts.name: Thinking Shimmer
parts.about: a turning sparkle and a quiet grey status line whose letters brighten in a band that keeps sweeping across

parts.name: Glossy Accent Ball
parts.about: a lit accent sphere (one key light, specular, floor bounce) falls, bounces twice and rests on a soft contact shadow

parts.name: Ball To Squircle Icon
parts.about: the glossy ball squashes into a rounded-square app icon and its glyph wipes on from the bottom

parts.name: Digit Odometer
parts.about: a big number whose digit columns roll like a mechanical counter, lower columns spinning with blur and higher ones stepping; a year rolls backwards

parts.role: the bill grows with the list
parts.name: Slot Price Reel
parts.about: a drum of rising values turns up one step per eighth note, rows curving away on the cylinder, the last value landing in accent

parts.name: Wavy Dot Loader
parts.about: a row of dots riding a travelling sine wave, a few flicking hollow: busy and going nowhere

parts.name: Stuck Import Wizard
parts.about: a big white wizard card with numbered steps, Done / In progress / Pending pills, a wavy loader and a bar that creeps to 99% and freezes

params.progress: 20, 68, 88, 95, 98, 99% over 1.7 s, then a shimmer going nowhere

parts.role: the user's agent tries to act
parts.name: Agent Terminal
parts.about: a dark rounded terminal fades from grey to black, an accent prompt types a plain-language command and status lines print under it

parts.role: agent trying to reach the tool
parts.name: Dashed Link Packets
parts.about: a marching accent dashed line between two endpoints with glowing packets travelling from sender to receiver

parts.name: Error Disc On The Link
parts.about: a glossy accent disc with a white X pops onto a connector with a ring pulse and keeps breathing; the packets die before it

parts.name: Mono Counter Pill
parts.about: a small black pill in mono reading a climbing count and two dot-separated tags

parts.name: Agent Tool-Call Panel
parts.about: a light panel with a mono header, a tinted prompt row that types the question, and tool-call lines whose status dots turn green as their results print

parts.name: Query Dot Grid
parts.about: a grid of dots fills in diagonally; matches turn accent and grow while the rest fade grey, and a found count lands above

parts.name: Workflow Pill Tick
parts.about: a black pill naming a workflow with a pulsing accent dot that turns into a drawn tick when the job is done

parts.name: Counter Card Vs Frozen Value
parts.about: two white cards: one total rolls up digit by digit, the other holds a frozen accent value with a lock that never moves

parts.name: Billboard With A Ball Stop
parts.about: one giant word slides in from the right with ghosts; a glossy accent ball drops, bounces twice and rests as its full stop

parts.name: Year Rolls Back Over Echo Rows
parts.about: a bracket caption types while its echo drifts in faint rows; a huge year rolls backwards (or a total climbs) and the ball lands as its full stop, then greys

parts.name: Stuck Import Wizard
parts.about: a bracket caption over a big import wizard: steps tick, the dot loader keeps waving, the bar creeps to 99% and freezes

parts.name: Hollow Dots Are The Stat
parts.about: a full-bleed dot matrix blooms out of the centre around a label window; the stat's share of dots empties to rings in random order; a column wave recolours them accent

parts.role: your list grew, so did the bill
parts.name: Slot Bill Roll
parts.about: a shimmering status line on the left while a drum of rising values turns up on the eighths; the last lands in accent with a ring and the line rewrites to the verdict

parts.role: your tool can't talk to agents
parts.name: Terminal Meets A Wall
parts.about: an agent terminal types its command, a grey legacy window fades in, packets run the dashed link, an error disc breaks it and the terminal jolts and prints the error

parts.name: Giant Word, Ticking Dots, Pull Back
parts.about: the first word huge and cropped off the left edge, its ellipsis dots tick in on the eighths with the ball as the third, then the camera snaps back to the whole sentence

parts.name: Ball Eats The Line, Bursts Into The Icon
parts.about: the ball rolls along the baseline swallowing each word, swells to the centre, bursts with specks and a ring, squashes into the app icon and its glyph wipes on

parts.name: Icon Slides, Wordmark Wipes
parts.about: the centred icon slides left as the wordmark wipes out from behind it with a blur, and the tagline types underneath with an accent tail

parts.role: works with the agent you already use
parts.name: Agents Wired To The Hub
parts.about: the app icon in dotted orbit rings, S-curve wires drawing out to four neutral glyph chips, accent packets running in and pulsing the hub, a mono counter pill below

parts.name: A Query Filters The Grid
parts.about: an agent panel types the question, the dot grid answers (matches turn accent, a count and a tag land), the matches stream out of the grid into a workflow pill that ticks

parts.role: pay for what you send, never for what you store
parts.name: Promise And Counter Cards
parts.about: a two-line promise in ink then accent, then two white cards: a total rolling up beside a frozen value with a lock

parts.name: Lockup, Wide Pill, Click
parts.about: app icon and wordmark centred, a wide accent CTA pill grows under it, the cursor glides in and clicks with a ripple, the address small below

parts.name: Zoom Into The Full Stop
parts.about: the camera accelerates into the outgoing shot's ball until its colour fills the frame, then the colour contracts into the next shot's first object

parts.name: Halftone Bloom
parts.about: a dot matrix grows out of the centre over the shot until the dots merge, then empties from the centre outward onto the next

parts.name: Glitch Double Cut
parts.about: the last frames double with an offset copy and two slipped slices, a hard cut, and the next shot settles out of one doubled frame

parts.name: Ball Swallows And Bursts
parts.about: the accent ball rolls across the shot and swells while the shot collapses into it, then bursts with a ring and specks and the next shot opens out of the burst

parts.name: Pull Back Snap
parts.about: the shot starts tight on its subject, creeps in, then snaps back to the full frame in a fast ease at the set-up's pull cue

parts.name: Truck Left With Push
parts.about: a slow lateral truck of about 30 px a second with a gentle push, for a held giant word

parts.name: Echo Marquee Rows
parts.about: the beat's line repeated in faint rows across the frame, alternate rows drifting left and right

parts.name: Ring Burst On Landing
parts.about: two thin accent rings expand and fade behind whatever just landed (the beat's exit object or its centre)

CTA pill that a cursor clicks
the slow push under most beats
the verdict line after the slot lands and the sentence after the pull back
